text: had some little special juice in my in my surf casting bag that I didn't think I was ever going to get a chance to utilize to match the hatch that well. So, I think it was about a year ago, maybe 2 years ago, No Live Bait Needed came out with an exclusive colorway with Rob Taylor called the Squid Billy. And it is almost identical to what these squid look like. I mean, it is to a T with all the little speckles and the different colors of amber and pink and red. And so, I had a 8-in with a 2-oz jig head and I started casting and did not take long to start hooking up on some quality fish in that high 20s, maybe low 30-lb range. I was electric. I was I was on cloud nine. The adrenaline was pumping through my veins.
